pages.title: A Story Bound
pages.text: Add your own photograph and text to a Photo Album, then sign it.

pages.title: A Story Bound
pages.text: Finish a photographed story; a spare album and shelves prepare the next volume.

pages.title: Getting started
pages.text: Signing makes the album uneditable, so review pages first. Display it on a Lectern. Prints can also be stacked and opened in the detailed zoomable viewer.

pages.title: Related possibilities
pages.text: Place printed photographs into a Photo Album; optionally sign the album to prevent editing. Archival/creative photography goal.

pages.title: Related possibilities
pages.text: Put a photograph into a Photograph Frame on a wall, floor or ceiling; apply a Glow Ink Sac if desired. Display a sized photograph, with an optional glowing frame.

pages.title: Related possibilities
pages.text: Add photographs and page text to an album, then sign and name it. Make the album uneditable; it can be displayed on a Lectern or stored in a Chiseled Bookshelf.

pages.title: Related possibilities
pages.text: Right-click a Photograph or Stacked Photographs with another photograph. Combine prints into a stack.

pages.title: Related possibilities
pages.text: Use a photograph to open its detailed viewer. Zoom and inspect it; author-owned images can be exported to the instance's exposures folder.
